description: This PHP class defines a Skill data transfer object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM system's reporting module. It extends a normalizable DTO and provides methods to serialize employee skill data, referencing Employee entities and utilizing traits for entity management.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: A DTO representing an employee's skill, capable of being normalized into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Skill DTO with a specific employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the employee's skills into an array based on provided fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping from field names to getter method chains for data extraction.
